title: Beyond QASecClaw: Agent Scaling, Verifier Feedback, and Evidence Reliability in Software Assurance
abstract: arXiv:2610.36947v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can additional specialist language-model contexts improve software assurance when deterministic tool evidence is already available? We study this question through five experiments spanning authored Java warning controls, OWASP Benchmark assessment, Defects4J test generation, SV-COMP assertion verdicts, and deliberately misleading evidence packages. The evaluated systems use Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct, with a 1.5B sensitivity analysis, and complete 13,638 model requests. On eight related development warnings, increasing the context count from 1 to 50 increases token use 49-fold without improving unsafe clearance. On 160 OWASP cases, model configurations trade clearance against unresolved outcomes; the ten-context arm assesses only 96 cases. On 32 SV-COMP tasks, raw verifier feedback raises mean correct model verdicts from 12.7 to 22.0, but also raises incorrect verdicts from one to seven; a JBMC-plus-JVM validation baseline returns 26 co

translated_title: 超越QASecClaw：软件保障中的智能体扩展、验证器反馈与证据可靠性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.36947v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：当确定性工具证据已经可用时，额外的专家级语言模型上下文能否改善软件保障？我们通过五个实验来研究这一问题，涵盖人工编写的Java警告控制、OWASP基准评估、Defects4J测试生成、SV-COMP断言判定，以及刻意误导性的证据包。所评估的系统使用Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct，并进行1.5B参数的敏感性分析，共完成13,638次模型请求。在八个相关的开发警告上，将上下文数量从1增加到50会使token使用量增加49倍，而未能改善不安全代码的放行情况。在160个OWASP案例中，各模型配置在放行与未解决结果之间进行权衡；十上下文配置仅评估了96个案例。在32个SV-COMP任务上，原始验证器反馈将模型判定的平均正确数从12.7提高到22.0，但也将错误判定从1个增加到7个；JBMC加JVM验证基线返回26个……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过五组实验表明，在软件保障任务中扩大语言模型智能体上下文规模会使token开销激增49倍却无安全收益，验证器反馈虽能提升正确判定数量但同时增加错误判定，说明确定性的工具证据基线仍然不可或缺。
en_tdlr: Through five experiments, this paper shows that in software assurance, scaling LLM agent contexts inflates token usage 49-fold without safety gains, and verifier feedback raises correct verdicts but also increases errors, underscoring that deterministic tool-evidence baselines remain essential.
